services.desc: Capt. Chuck of Chill’s Light Tackle Guide Service recently had a last-minute booking on the Upper Chesapeake Bay that turned into a first-class trip. Rob and Alan, the clients for the day, enjoyed an unforgettable fishing adventure, catching numerous striped bass (rockfish). Despite the short notice, Capt. Chuck’s expertise ensured a productive and exciting day on the water. Rob and Alan were thrilled with their haul and were able to take some of their catch home to enjoy. The photos say it all - another successful outing with Chill’s Light Tackle Guide Service, creating lasting memories on the Chesapeake Bay. Whether you’re a seasoned angler or a novice, Capt.
